mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 讲微生物如何影响身心健康、疾病如何传播、疫苗如何问世。仿写训练精选课文金句，练‘go beyond...to、过去分词后置定语、Thanks to’的句式迁移。

items.focusType: go beyond A to B 递进结构
items.focus: 用 ‘go beyond A to B’ 表达‘不止于 A，更延伸到 B’，一句话完成范围的层层推进。
items.original: The influence of microorganisms goes beyond physical health to our cognitive and psychological well-being.
items.cn: 微生物的影响超越了身体健康，延伸到我们的认知与心理健康。

models.en: The value of reading goes beyond passing exams to shaping how we think and feel.
A good teacher's influence goes beyond the classroom to the whole course of a student's life.

items.tip: beyond 与 to 搭配，构成‘从……到……’的递进；A、B 词性要对称。

items.focusType: 过去分词短语作后置定语
items.focus: 名词后用 V-ed 短语作后置定语，相当于一个被动的定语从句，让句子紧凑有信息量。
items.original: The disease spreads through tiny respiratory droplets released when people cough or sneeze.
items.cn: 这种疾病通过人们咳嗽或打喷嚏时释放的微小呼吸道飞沫传播。

models.en: The message hidden in her calm smile was understood by no one but her closest friend.
Rumours spread through careless words repeated without a second thought.

items.tip: released = that are released；过去分词表被动，现在分词表主动，别用混。

items.focus: 用 ‘Thanks to + 原因’ 开头表示‘多亏/得益于’，再引出好的结果，语气积极。
items.original: Thanks to years of research, scientists finally rolled out an effective vaccine against the virus.
items.cn: 得益于多年研究，科学家们终于推出了针对这种病毒的有效疫苗。

models.en: Thanks to the encouragement of my teacher, I gradually found the courage to speak in public.
Thanks to countless volunteers, the flooded town was cleaned up within a single week.

items.tip: Thanks to 多接积极结果；若是消极结果或中性原因，用 Because of / Owing to 更稳妥。
